page_note: Page has two distinct units. Segments 0-11 close out a polemical unit about 'Death which is king in all the doctrines (ⲇⲟⲅⲙⲁ)' and the 'tree of Error' that takes captive — vocabulary points outward at rival sects. Segments 12-36 open Chapter 6, 'Concerning the five storehouses' — the substantive cosmological question and the substrate teaching of the five worlds, five archons, five spirits, five bodies/tastes, five trees, five creature-kinds, and the King of Darkness with his five zoomorphic forms (head, hands/feet, shoulders like eagles). Strong substrate dominance in second half (fatigue score -4.79, substrate shift +9.6). The seam at i=17 is the standard 'Yet again the Illuminator says' frame; extracted teaching content. Heavy damage (83.8%) but enumeration structure and zoomorphic correspondence are clearly preserved.
